description: Limits of the game GUI arrangement: scale is the smallest and largest scale a block may take; move is how many pixels a block's corner may lie outside its screen; photo is the photo mode's buttons: toggle turns it on, any of dismiss turns it off (the press is the mode's, not the game's); the screens that have the mode say so with `photo`, and a screen's `photo_toggle` turns it on there instead of toggle.
